domains.name: Law, memory, loss and continuing consequences
domains.pq: PQ-149, PQ-150, PQ-151, PQ-154; CV-SO, CR-WEIR
domains.facts: Durable wrecks, bounded loss provenance, lawful action authorization and remembered relations already exist. A failure should change the next playable situation; avoid merely adding another notification or reputation scalar.
domains.contract: Preserve canonical heat/faction writers and provenance. Knowledge is local evidence, not an omniscient police feed. Do not overwrite mission-bearing labels with unrelated ledger events. Consequence rewards are idempotent.
domains.route: Cause or witness the relevant event, leave, meet the affected actor/service or find the wreck again, then take a physical action that changes the consequence.

domains.name: Exploration, spatial clues and returnable destinations
domains.facts: Scanning already reveals matched wreck provenance in layers and grants bounded investigation rewards. Discovery work should create useful incomplete information and a return reason, not another floating marker or repeatable payout.
domains.contract: Use existing scanner, site and world-record owners. Distinguish knowledge from reward entitlement. Coordinate-space transforms and persistent world identity must remain consistent across map, collision and materialization.
domains.route: Notice a clue during ordinary travel, follow it using movement/scanner/terrain, act on the discovery, leave, and make practical use of remembering the place.

domains.name: Vethari ecology: bounded, canon-preserving expansion
domains.lane: THE WORLD / THE LONG GAME — conditional later slice
domains.facts: A substantial alien-ecology plan already exists. Its first phase derives bounded local contamination through current owners; it does not authorize a new universal spread simulator or a second fungal civilization.
domains.contract: One biological phenomenon tied to Vethari; finite/noisy connection, no new brain mass, no omniscient hive and no telepathic exposition. Precursor machines are a separate remnant layer. Preserve source/host/carrier distinctions and all current save/cargo/law owners.
domains.route: Only after the upstream vertical slice is real: approach a reachable contaminated place, infer one local rule, use an existing tool, and revisit its bounded consequence.

domains.name: Causal VFX, force shapes and readable impact
domains.facts: There is already a presentation orchestrator, semantic recipes, force-language geometry and specialized projectile/bomb motion. Existing lifecycle tests cover field winding/decay; distinguish a missing hookup or visibility defect from absent mechanics.
domains.contract: VFX never changes simulation outcomes. Read fenced presentation state and the correct clock. Use authored geometry/strands/surfaces, not camera-facing fuzzy discs. Maintain ownership, pool reset, reduced-motion/flash information and default visual quality.
domains.route: Trigger the effect through normal gameplay at normal zoom in open space, beside a bright station and inside a mixed Swarm fight.

domains.name: Authored bodies, place legibility and camera composition
domains.pq: PQ-190, PQ-193, PQ-159; CV-GLASS, CV-PAINT, CV-MOTION
domains.facts: The game already separates camera/tabletop policy, visibility, authored body LOD and infrastructure motion. The source packet omits media, so no current mesh-quality verdict is justified without the full runtime assets.
domains.contract: Ship bodies use Forge and the current material language. Manifest/release/runtime evidence outranks prose inventory. Keep on-screen authored bodies, collision truth, physical sockets and silhouette identity across LOD; do not fix performance by lowering default art quality.
domains.route: Use the normal flight camera around the player, one enemy and one destination, then inspect close/medium/distant presentation and a return after streaming.

domains.name: Action voice, spatial sound and musical restraint
domains.facts: Audio already has hybrid authored/synth recipes, priority ducking, spatial environment mixing, Massline/bomb families and a self-owned runtime loop. It is init-only in the registry, not an ordinary update-order system.
domains.contract: Do not add a second audio update loop or AudioContext. Preserve gesture resume, bounded voices, sample licensing and desired-loop recovery. Critical information needs a nonaudio equivalent; loudness is not importance.
domains.route: Start with no gesture/unlock, enter normal flight, combine engines, rope, impacts and comms, then pause/resume and revisit a quieter destination.

domains.name: Functional ORRERY workflows, comprehension and accessibility
domains.lane: THE INSTRUMENT — functional integration, not parallel redesign
domains.pq: Current ORRERY direction; PQ-163, PQ-164, PQ-165
domains.facts: ORRERY is the current visual authority. The lane owns redesign; minimal task-required functional UI changes are explicitly allowed. Do not revive retired generic card/table or printed-material visual briefs.
domains.contract: Screens compose existing ORRERY library elements. UI reads sim state and emits intents; no credits/cargo/physics writes. Preserve focus, pause ownership, remaps and reduced-motion semantics. Foreign dirty exact paths stay protected.
domains.route: Perform the named task from a normal screen entry using pointer and keyboard/controller focus, cancel it, reopen it and complete it while state changes underneath.

domains.name: Streaming, frame pacing and quality-preserving performance
domains.facts: The repo has extensive admission, cooking, residency and presentation machinery. D38/D61/D36/D74 describe residual paths; some old fixes are already landed. Quiet-machine release acceptance is parked, but attribution and production fixes are not.
domains.contract: Measure the changed path on the actual device/load, preserve authored visuals and default quality, and keep presentation/sim ownership intact. Async results must prove current generation at commit time. No hidden fallback, timeout inflation or diagnostic-only completion.
domains.route: Use normal New Game, a dense fight, high-speed travel and repeated sector/Works transitions on the same host/settings; classify cold and warm behavior separately.

domains.name: Save continuity, interruption safety and durable player trust
domains.lane: THE MACHINE / THE HAND / THE LONG GAME
domains.facts: Save import already validates before destructive restore and enforces bounds. Current transitions use branded/latest-wins ownership; nav and world records have stable identity helpers. Continuity plans strengthen edge paths instead of replacing this architecture.
domains.contract: Preserve atomic restore, settings normalization, transient request ownership and one shared Browser/Electron game path. Never use the real player save directory in tests or loosen import safety to accept malformed data.
domains.route: Perform the actual player action, interrupt at its meaningful boundary, load or resume through normal entry, then continue the same task without duplicate rewards or lost input.

domains.name: Integrated moments, design recovery and quality convergence
domains.lane: Cross-lane, one integration owner per selected slice
domains.pq: CV-HAND, CV-DAY, CV-SO, CR-CHAIN, CR-TEXTURE; existing finishing lanes
domains.facts: Many individual systems are already implemented. The risk is that their receipts say done while a normal route still feels thin, confusing or disconnected. These are concrete production slices, not another acceptance/reporting campaign.
domains.contract: Borrow existing owners; do not introduce a super-manager, a second queue or a release signoff gate. Each slice must change real reachable play and preserve the current owner fantasy and role separation.
domains.route: Play the complete before/after sequence from its ordinary entry, including an imperfect outcome and a return visit where relevant.
